notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 – Full Release Incoming!
notes.notes:
Dear Pilots;


After months of working day and night, we’re finally approaching the full release of SpaceBourne 2! Over this time, we’ve rebuilt the faction system from the ground up, redesigned the HUD entirely, and polished countless missions and features. We’ve also expanded the universe with new dungeons and stations, deepened diplomacy to make galactic politics more engaging, and added full gamepad support for a smoother gameplay experience.



 Another major step forward is that much of the voice acting has been re-recorded by professional voice actors, bringing even more life to the characters and the world. Alongside these major additions, we’ve implemented more than 800 improvements and fixes — including enhanced SFX and FX, refined dialogues, story improvements, galaxy generation upgrades, and hundreds of other adjustments — ensuring SpaceBourne 2 is more stable, immersive, and enjoyable than ever before. 



We expect to be ready within September, and we truly appreciate your patience throughout this journey. In the coming weeks, we’ll be running a closed beta for the full release, and it will be our beta testers who ultimately decide whether the game is ready. If they feel we should remain in Early Access a little longer, the full release may be postponed slightly — but we believe we are very close to being fully ready.



If you’d like to help us during this process, you can reach out to our community manager @volkan via our Discord server.

Also; We would like to clarify this issue as we have received numerous reports regarding it:
If your soldiers are leaving the Faction, please check if the path you have chosen for the Faction and the changes you have made in the Constitution is in line with that path. 

For example, if you have chosen the Order path and set the Neutral Civil Policy to "Kill on sight", your soldiers' loyalty will decrease and at some point, they will leave the army.
